findings.claim: R41 requires combined flow figures 'after removing paired own-account transfers'. compute_case computes combined flows from each account's categorised lines and does no own-account pairing; R8 is implemented nowhere in src (only the per-account possible-transfer listing in indicators.py:417). An inter-account transfer that neither the rule table nor the profile names is counted on both sides of the combined figures, inflating combined money in and money out, which is the reply's 'counted twice' concern. The producer acknowledges this (disposition 'reproduced'). tasks.json:609-611 makes T34 (R8) depend on T33, so the clause sits in a dependency cycle that needs an owner scope decision: move the pairing clause to T34, or reorder or merge T33 and T34.
